rules.rationale: Tracked GitHub workflow declarations, not a claim of green CI
Human-facing documentation with no runtime authority
Versioned product, source, and proof contract declarations
Project EDU runtime owner implementation declarations only
Versioned Project EDU documentation and generated atlases
Local source tooling; invocation, execution, release not attested
Shared JavaScript source; authority and dynamic consumers unknown
Versioned tests; presence does not certify execution or equivalence
